root_cause_fixed: ParakeetFeatureExtractor.__call__ normalizes mel features per band after the log: mean over valid frames, variance with the unbiased (features_lengths - 1) denominator, then (x - mean) / (std + 1e-5), masked. _torch_extract_fbank_features does not, which is why our earlier comparisons diverged by ~18 log units.

residual.pattern: Concentrated in 12 mel bands (0,1,2,71-75 and others) across 111 frames, consistent with a per-band mean/variance reduction precision difference rather than a spectral or filterbank error.
residual.precedent: The same class of divergence exists in the Orukeet pure-silence case, where the official masked float32 reduction was the identified cause.

frames.note: The official centered STFT yields 1101 frames but features_lengths = floor((audio_length + n_fft - n_fft)/hop) = 1100, so the official mask and normalization cover 1100. Enabling includeCenteredTailFrame was tested and regressed parity to max 3.28, so the clamp is correct.

shipped: Still no preset, adapter or manifest; this is frontend parity evidence only.
